senses.gloss:
बिभ्रक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
 1. Desirous to destroy or lose.
 2. Wishing to
scorch, fry, parch.
 m. (-क्षुः) Fire.
 E. भ्रस्ज् to break, to fry, desid.
v., उ aff.

बिभ्रज्जिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to fry or scorch.
 m. (-षुः) Fire. E.
भ्रस्ज् to fry, desid, v., उ aff.

बीभत्स mfn. Subst. (-त्सः-त्सा-त्सं)
 1. Disgust, abhorrence. Adj. Detesting,
loathing, changed or averted in mind.
 2. Cruel, mischievous.
 3.
Compassionate.
 4. Wicked.
 5. Envious.
 E. बध् to bind, to hate, &c.
aff. घञ् ।
